gnasher.verdict: Accept: final QA retry retained yellow eyes; distinct open jaw, green collar and crouching four-foot pose.
gnasher.prompt: Front-facing, centred, symmetrical where sensible, whole body visible and filling about 80% of the frame, floating on a solid flat magenta background (#FF00FF) with NO ground, NO shadow and NO scenery. Strict 8-bit pixel art in the style of Phantasy Star on the Sega Master System: hard square pixels, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no dithering on the body, flat colours with 2-3 tone hard shading, thick black outline around every shape. At most 16 colours, all from the Sega Master System 64-colour palette (every RGB channel 00, 55, AA or FF), biased to the Verdant Decks palette: blues (#0000AA, #0055FF, #00AAFF), cyans (#00FFFF, #AAFFFF), greens (#005500, #00AA00, #55FF55, #AAFF00) and purples (#5500AA, #AA00FF, #AA55FF), plus black (#000000) and white (#FFFFFF), with exactly one warm accent of pollen yellow or ember orange (#FFFF00 or #FFAA00); no pink or magenta anywhere on the creature. Drawn as if 64x64 pixels upscaled with nearest neighbour. No text, no border, no watermark, single subject. Subject: a knee-high cyan lizard-pup in a crouching pounce, its oversized jaw gaping open to show purple gums and white needle teeth; a green frill flared around its neck like a collar; four stubby clawed feet and a short curled tail.
gnasher.change: Final contact-sheet QA found yellow eyes had merged into lime green. Added two large flat pollen-yellow eyes with black pupils, at least four logical pixels per eye and distinct from green frill.
